body:
Do not sell the catch until the county finishes its water check. They called it routine, but the fish order is still in the icebox and the supplier wants payment.

I meant to ask about it in the morning. By then the person who could answer had gone with the last vehicle, and this was all that remained.

I thought someone would ask for this at the gate. They asked instead how many were in the car, and let the paper stay in my hand.
title: The unfinished handoff
gloss: A restaurant order remains unpaid while a routine water check delays the catch.
rival_reading: Officials could have restricted food during an emergency; the note never says what the water check was looking for.

body: green crop residue marks the empty sandbag; a scraped warning stripe marks the water bottle. both are tied with the same cord.
title: Empty sandbag with the second residue
gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
